extracted.intended_audience: students and general readers of Dutch/early-modern European history
extracted.subtask_description: A textbook-style excerpt recounting events in the Netherlands circa 1566 — the rise of the Geuzen, actions of Margaretha of Parma, William of Orange, iconoclasm (beeldstorm), and political-religious tensions. It is a narrative intended to inform about causes, actors, and consequences of the unrest.
